jen-support: heads-up — customer `acme-prod` is seeing a spike of 502s + invalid-structure errors when calling /v1/generate with JSON mode. started ~2025-11-02 17:31 UTC. sample request and model output below. filing a support ticket but need quick mitigations and repro steps.

alex-runtime: can you paste the exact prompt and the raw model response? streaming or non-streaming?

jen-support: non-streaming. prompt (trimmed):
```
System: You are a response formatter. Return ONLY JSON matching the schema.
User: Generate order object for customer 12345 with items and totals.
Schema: {"order_id": int, "items": [{"sku": str, "qty": int}], "total": float}
```
raw model output (copied from logs):
```
{"order_id": 9876, "items": [{"sku": "ABC", "qty": 2}, {"sku": "DEF", "qty": 1}], "total": 49.97}

Note: thank you for your order! we hope you enjoy.
```

maria-ml: that trailing human sentence is classic output-suffix leakage. when we attempt to parse we get a JSON decode error because of the appended text. looks like streaming final token appended after the json close brace.

sam-ops: any 502s correlate with throttling or gateway timeouts? logs show 502 spikes coincide with retries from SDK within the same client session — could be our auto-retry sending the request multiple times, compounding rate limits.

jen-support: repro steps I've been using (works locally):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","mode":"json","prompt":"(see above)"}'
```
response occasionally contains appended text after the JSON block. sometimes there's a stray trailing comma in arrays too.

alex-runtime: quick mitigation options: 1) implement a sanitizer in the SDK that extracts the first JSON object/array block using a greedy regex and attempts a lightweight fix (remove trailing commas, strip non-json suffix) before raising parse error; 2) fallback to re-ask prompt with an explicit "Return ONLY JSON, nothing else" — but rate-limit re-asks with exponential backoff; 3) for streaming customers, ensure we close the stream on first valid JSON close brace.

maria-ml: for re-ask template I recommend: "You must output VALID JSON and nothing else. If you are unsure, output null for the field. Do not include commentary or greetings." keep it short. also add a clamp like: `max_tokens: 128` to avoid extra prose.

jen-support: alex, can you share the regex sanitizer snippet you mentioned? we can push as a hotfix to our node/python SDKs for GA accounts.

alex-runtime: basic heuristic we used in a PoC:
```js
// find first balanced JSON object or array
const match = /(^\s*[\[{].*[\]}]\s*)/s.exec(responseText);
if (match) candidate = match[1];
// quick cleanup: remove trailing commas in arrays/objects
candidate = candidate.replace(/,\s*([}\]])/g, '$1');
```
This handles a lot of cases but is best-effort. Will open PR to add as opt-in `response_sanitizer: true` in SDK.

sam-ops: operationally, let's also roll a temporary routing rule: if parse-fail rate > 1% for a customer and error class == STRUCT_PARSE, route to a lower-latency model variant and throttle retries to 1 with backoff 500ms->1s->2s. avoids request storms.

jen-support: created ticket SUP-2025-412. adding logs and sample responses. priority: P2. requesting eng-runtime oncall for a deeper look. @alex-runtime @maria-ml can you own a short investigation?

alex-runtime: I'll take initial triage. first hypotheses: 1) tokenizer or finalizer bug in runtime that emits extra tokens; 2) our streaming buffer concatenation appends extra post-processing text for some model variants. I'll grep runtime logs around model-host handshake.

maria-ml: I'll run a small evaluation: feed various prompts and check distribution of non-json suffix tokens across model versions and quantization profiles. particularly looking for patterns where suffix tokens start with lower-case greetings.

repro-bot: quick automated run (sample set=50 requests) finished: 8/50 non-parse events. models tested: redwood-small-v1, redwood-mini-v2. non-parse modes: trailing-suffix (5), trailing-comma (2), truncated-stream (1). uploaded results to SUP-2025-412.

jen-support: action items: alex -> runtime logs + canary flag for streaming finalizer; maria -> eval across versions + share n-gram suffix list; sam -> implement temporary routing throttle and enable SDK sanitizer opt-in; jen -> keep customer updated and provide workaround (SDK sanitizer + set max_tokens).

alex-runtime: timeline: will attempt to reproduce in staging today; if confirmed, ship a configuration toggle within 24-48h to alter finalizer behavior.

sam-ops: I'll also add a short-term metric: proportion_of_requests_with_struct_parse_error per customer and a PagerDuty rule if >2% for 10m.

jen-support: thanks all. updating the ticket and messaging customer with SDK-workaround and ETA. :white_check_mark:

alex-runtime: ping me if you see any 5xx logs with model-host trace id starting with mh-; that's probably the case I'm chasing.

maria-ml: also consider adding a small validation step server-side: attempt a quick JSON parse and if it fails, call a lightweight re-ask instead of immediately surfacing to customer. that saves noisy errors.

jen-support: noted. I'll attach the repro curl and the PoC regex in the ticket. meeting over; will follow up in thread.
